borrowing: Both trial drafts applied the 17:42 withdrawal on the same activation that chose Offset. The ordered trial kept the choice and put Mini in focus, with the timestamped update outside the 390 px viewport.
audit_scope: Keyboard-only Chromium replay at 320, 390 and 1440 CSS px. The whole-forecast geometry proxy was stricter than required, so the ordered poetry receipt also reads individual controls and the actual new estimate.
